EXECUTIVE THESIS
EVIDENCE-BOUND
HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED
AI scale is real. Value management has not caught up.

The airline demo has meaningful AI adoption across coding, analytics, ERP, service and workforce platforms, but leadership cannot yet treat the portfolio as realized value. The management question is no longer whether AI is being used. It is which funded claims can be converted into finance-validated outcomes.

What is proven

444 architecture nodes and 586 evidenced flows show AI operating inside a large, connected technology estate.

What is not proven

162 governed value claims remain outside the claimable threshold because baseline, outcome, and attestation evidence is incomplete.
